release: Independent projections before sportsbook comparison, and verified original-image reader fixes

automated_tests.scope: Full unittest discovery; sandbox-only async heartbeat runner

actual_screenshot_validation.method: Separate manual visual inspection of all four originals, exact comparison of extracted player/team/stat/threshold/side and side-specific offer type

independent_research_validation.known_limit: Current saved opponent history is insufficient for the eight-observation workload gate; no opponent filler is invented.

limits: Independent targets are a heuristic buffer around projections, not observed PrizePicks quotes or calibrated win probabilities.
Only existing dataset entities and supported metrics are considered; insufficient samples, stale sources and relevant reported absences can prevent a complete list.
Current injury coverage and schedule rechecks remain partial. Real provider timing and post-deployment message delivery require a live check.
The 17 supported screenshot markets match the supplied originals; this does not guarantee arbitrary future screen layouts.
Original screenshot and dataset tests were local/read-only or used temporary copies; no actual entry or settlement was created.
